scope: Reviewed facts for the copied Towhee implementation, not universal atom assignment

framework_charge_policy.default_source: independently assigned and approved CIF charges (PACMAN/PACMOF or validated DFT charge workflow), not forcefield Base Charge/bond increments
requirements: declared source and expected cell net charge
forbidden_actions: infer framework charges from this forcefield catalog
fill missing framework charges with zero
force significant residual onto one atom to make the sum zero
framework_charge_policy.guest_scope: Guest molecular charges remain a separate validated molecular model; framework policy does not overwrite OPLS/TIP4P guest charges.

UFF.type_label_convention: The third character is a geometry code, NOT generally a coordination number or oxidation state: 1 linear, 2 trigonal, R resonant, 3 tetrahedral, 4 square planar, 5 trigonal bipyramidal, 6 octahedral. Suffixes distinguish additional states, including metal charge-state labels.
UFF.iron_coefficient_consistency: In the copied towhee_ff_UFF, Fe3+2 and Fe6+2 have identical first two nonbond coefficients: 2.594297067 and 6.5418158. Their geometry coefficient at zero-based index 5 differs (109.47 versus 90.0); it is NOT an epsilon of 9.0 or 90.0 K. These records do not support a 27% well-depth difference. Preserve potential-dependent coefficient semantics; numeric arrays use the same zero-based order as raw arrays.
UFF.forbidden_inference: Fe3+2 is not Fe(III), Fe6+2 is not Fe(VI), and geometry code 3 does not mean three-coordinate. The +2 label is not a final per-site partial charge. No automatic assignment to an unspecified structure is justified.
UFF.charge_scope: Original UFF parameters were derived without atomic point charges; adding independently approved framework CIF charges defines an additional electrostatic model requiring validation, not original UFF charge assignment. Never infer zero or +2 partial charges from these labels or the catalog.

COMPASSv1.potential_formula: E(r) = epsilon * [2*(sigma/r)^9 - 3*(sigma/r)^6]; sigma is the minimum-energy distance in this convention, not the 12-6 LJ zero-crossing distance.
COMPASSv1.well_depth_check: Both this COMPASS 9-6 convention and standard 4*epsilon*[(sigma/r)^12-(sigma/r)^6] have minimum E=-epsilon and well depth epsilon. The 12-6 prefactor 4 does NOT mean a well depth of 4*epsilon.
COMPASSv1.engine_unit_boundary: Towhee raw epsilon is in kelvin (epsilon/k_B). LAMMPS lj/class2 epsilon must use the selected LAMMPS energy units. For real/metal units, raw kelvin values cannot be used unchanged: an explicit validated unit conversion is required. lj/class2 names only the pair potential, not a full bonded/electrostatic model or a project execution adapter.

sixthpower_mixing.self_pair_check: When i=j, sigma_ij=sigma_i and epsilon_ij=epsilon_i. A harmonic-mean expression without the sqrt prefactor fails this check.

COMPASSv1.lammps_reference: lj/class2 is the documented COMPASS 9-6 style with sixthpower epsilon/sigma mixing. lj96/cut uses a different normalization and cannot consume these raw parameters unchanged. A named engine style is not an implemented project adapter.
COMPASSv1.conversion_limits: 9-6 and 12-6 cannot be made identical at every distance by changing two coefficients. A fitted approximation changes the model and needs scientific validation and explicit user approval; do not silently replace the forcefield.
COMPASSv1.charge_scope: Towhee supports guest bond-increment assignment with verified types/connectivity. This project's copied increment table is not yet parsed/assigned; it never overrides the independent approved framework CIF charge workflow.

atom_environments.C k: carbonyl carbon in C=O, not bonded to N, not an acid group; not a benzene or propane carbon type

OPLS-aa.molecular_charge_assignment: Requires the chosen molecule's validated OPLS charge model or literature evidence. This copied file has zero Bond Increments; Base Charge cannot supply a complete increment-based charge assignment.
OPLS-aa.forbidden_inference: Do not invent a bond-increment table or assume all OPLS molecular charges are Base Charge plus increments.

TIP4P.representation: original rigid four-site TIP4P implementation; not automatically TIP4P/2005 or TIP4P/ice
TIP4P.charge_source: Towhee official TIP4P documentation, not the zero Base Charge fields
TIP4P.virtual_site: M lies on the H-O-H bisector; oxygen is the LJ site, M carries the negative point charge
TIP4P.forbidden_inference: Do not put -1.04 on oxygen or claim the original file lacks geometry. Unparsed bonded sections are not absent sections.

global_limits: Preserved original bonded coefficients are not a parsed/assigned bonded model.
Exact chemical environments, coordination, oxidation state and charge sources must be checked before atom assignment.
A substring query with zero matches does not establish absence of a whole scientific model family.
Larger atom-type counts or element presence do not establish applicability.
